description: This file defines the NotePreviewFragment class, which is an Android Fragment responsible for displaying a preview of a note in the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It manages UI components, handles note loading, refresh actions, and link interactions within the note content.

classes.name: NotePreviewFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment class that provides a preview view for notes, including functionalities like loading note content, handling refresh actions, link interactions, and applying branding.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the options menu, toggling visibility of menu items based on the current state.

methods.name: getScrollView
methods.description: Returns the ScrollView component used in the fragment.

methods.name: scrollToY
methods.description: Scrolls the view to a specific Y position.

methods.name: getSearchNextButton
methods.description: Returns the button used to navigate to the next search result.

methods.name: getSearchPrevButton
methods.description: Returns the button used to navigate to the previous search result.

methods.name: getDirectEditingButton
methods.description: Returns the button for direct editing of the note.

methods.name: getNormalEditButton
methods.description: Returns the button for normal editing mode.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Returns the layout of the note content.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components and preferences after activity creation.

methods.name: onNoteLoaded
methods.description: Handles the logic after a note has been loaded, including setting content and observing changes.

methods.name: registerInternalNoteLinkHandler
methods.description: Sets up link click handling within the note content.

methods.name: colorWithText
methods.description: Highlights or colors text within the note content.

methods.name: onRefresh
methods.description: Handles the swipe-to-refresh action to sync note content.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding colors and styles to the note content.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the fragment with specified account and note IDs.
